product: DRAM including HBM3E, HBM4 and 12-layer HBM4E samples shipped 2026-06-18, plus NAND, eSSD, multi-chip packages and CMOS image sensors. It co-unveiled first HBF standard specifications with Sandisk on 2026-08-04 and demonstrated an iHBM thermal solution.
demand: AI data-centre buildout is the driver. SK hynix signed long-term agreements with around 10 key customers and cites Omdia's 19 percent DRAM and NAND CAGR to 2030. Supply cannot expand quickly: chips are exported as soon as produced and HBM consumes far more wafer area per gigabyte than standard DRAM.
pricing_power: Strong and rising. HBM export price hit USD 76.13 at end-July 2026, up 9.5 percent month over month, while DRAM export price rose 24.3 percent. 2Q26 operating margin was 76 percent. Third-party data puts HBM4 at roughly USD 550 per 36GB stack. Long-term agreements lock volume and price with major customers.
competition: A three-player oligopoly with Samsung Electronics and Micron, plus emerging Chinese commodity DRAM supply. SK hynix leads HBM with roughly 50 to 55 percent share, but Samsung's HBM4 yields are improving and Micron is qualifying HBM4 for Nvidia's Rubin platform, so leadership remains contestable.
team: No leadership or board changes were found in the last 90 days. SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said on 2026-09-01 that SK hynix is considering a semiconductor plant in Japan. Management holds quarterly earnings calls, published analyst interviews on 2026-08-14, and the board decided the KRW 40T buyback on 2026-08-19.
market_strategy: Add capacity and return cash. KRW 54T for Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17, a KRW 600T Yongin masterplan targeted for completion by 2033, and a US HBM base in Indiana. Widen the investor base through the July 2026 Nasdaq ADS listing and SK hynix Ventures in Silicon Valley. Return more than 50 percent of cumulative 2025-2027 FCF.
bull: 2Q26 revenue KRW 79.32T and 76% operating margin on HBM/DRAM price gains; HBM export price USD 76.13, up 9.5% m/m; KRW 40T buyback with cancellation; Citi, Goldman, JPMorgan dated Buy reiterations.
bear: Volume fell 27.3% while price drove revenue; Samsung near 80% HBM4 yields and Micron qualifying Rubin HBM4; Barclays cut target 2026-07-30; shares fell 1.54% on 2026-09-24 despite a raise.
falsifier: 3Q26 earnings on 2026-10-27 showing HBM or DRAM average selling prices falling versus 2Q26, or operating profit below the KRW 60.54T reported for 2Q26.
web_what_changed: 2026-07-29: 2Q26 record results, revenue KRW 79.3187T, operating profit KRW 60.5426T. 2026-08-07: board approved KRW 54T for Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17 fabs. 2026-08-19: KRW 40T buyback with full cancellation, about 3.3% of shares, starting Aug 20. 2026-08-28 Indiana HBM groundbreaking; 2026-09-18 SK hynix Ventures launched; 2026-07-10 to 07-14 Nasdaq ADS listing. All KRW figures are KRX 000660 listing currency.
web_not_known_yesterday: Nothing materially new dated 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25 beyond 2026-09-23 analyst actions: Citi reiterated Buy with a KRW 3,000,000 target and Wolfe Research raised its target to USD 250. The end-July HBM export price of USD 76.13 was published 2026-09-01. The IR site shows no new filing and marketscreener lists no upcoming events.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Mainly price. 2Q26 revenue rose 257 percent year over year on higher average selling prices for AI-server DRAM, HBM and eSSD. HBM export price reached USD 76.13 at end-July, up 9.5 percent month over month, while shipment volume fell 27.3 percent. DRAM export price rose 24.3 percent to USD 22.9. Mirae projects DRAM prices up 15.8 percent in 3Q26 and 7.2 percent in 4Q26.
web_suppliers: Key equipment supplier is Hanmi Semiconductor, which won KRW 44.2 billion of HBM4 TC bonder orders from SK hynix on 2026-06-08 for delivery in early September 2026. Wafer-fab tools come from vendors such as ASML, Applied Materials and Tokyo Electron. The binding constraint is capacity and power and water build-out, not parts; Yongin phase 1 infrastructure was 99 percent complete as of 2026-08-07.
web_customers: Concentrated in AI. The company reports long-term agreements with around 10 key customers as of 2026-07-29. Nvidia is the anchor, with a multi-year technology partnership announced 2026-06-07 and an expanded SK Group and NVIDIA partnership on 2026-07-25. Other named customers include Microsoft, Apple, Dell, HPE, Asus and MSI. HBM4 supplies Nvidia Vera Rubin.
web_who_loses: Samsung Electronics and Micron lose pricing power if SK hynix holds HBM leadership, though both are catching up. Memory buyers lose: PC, smartphone and server OEMs plus module makers absorb higher DRAM and NAND prices. Samsung is weighing converting a Pyeongtaek foundry line to memory production. Chinese commodity DRAM entrants such as CXMT face the same tight supply economics.
web_contradicting_evidence: Samsung is closing the HBM4 gap, with reports of roughly 80 percent HBM4 yields for Nvidia Rubin; Korean press on 2026-09-15 said Samsung and SK hynix growth outlooks are diverging in Samsung's favour. Micron is qualifying HBM4 for Rubin as of 2026-09-22. Barclays cut its target to USD 300 from USD 330 on 2026-07-30. Shares fell 1.54 percent on 2026-09-24 despite a target raise.
web_if_management_right: Management calls AI memory demand structural and cites Omdia's 19 percent DRAM and NAND CAGR through 2030. Record pricing then persists: consensus FY26 revenue about KRW 346.5T and operating profit about KRW 267.7T. Yongin Y1 first cleanroom in February 2027, Cheongju M17 in December 2028, Yongin Y2 in June 2029, with over 50 percent of cumulative FCF returned and KRW 40T of shares cancelled.
web_if_management_wrong: Memory prices roll over and operating leverage reverses, as in FY2023 when operating profit was negative KRW 7.73T. First break is price-led revenue with falling unit volumes, then KRW 54T of new fab capex and the KRW 600T Yongin master plan become stranded depreciation. Repurchasing KRW 40T of stock near cyclical highs destroys capital, and Nvidia-heavy demand leaves little offset.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Equipment and materials makers first: Hanmi Semiconductor plus other HBM bonding, test, substrate and back-end suppliers, including the Japanese materials, parts and equipment targets SK is reviewing. Then Yongin and Cheongju construction and power and water infrastructure providers, SK Group affiliates, and SK hynix Ventures portfolio companies. Nvidia and hyperscalers gain from added memory supply.
